verdict.rationale: Opting out of telemetry is a fair question for a hosted API like Jina Reader, but no evidence item mentions telemetry, usage tracking, or any opt-out control. The self-hostable container image is a deployment option, not a documented telemetry opt-out, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
